about: Golden cases for the scope guard's path rules (scripts/scope-guard.mjs, scripts/areas.json). The AI comparison itself is not tested here.

cases.name: a lesson file belongs to its track
a project package belongs to its track
the build-concepts script belongs to the How it works page, not the shared shell
shared layout belongs to the site shell
a workflow belongs to the agents
the sitemap is generated, so it belongs to every area
a lesson draft in one track passes
a lesson draft that also edits a workflow is blocked
a lesson draft that spans two tracks is blocked
the intern's wording fix may not touch the ecosystem page
an ordinary branch may change several areas (the AI comparison judges it)
the efficiency agent may not spread over three areas
the efficiency agent may change two areas
a new track may add itself to tracks.js (site shell) and nothing else
a lesson draft may not change the site shell without a track
